families.region: Minnesota lake country: Mille Lacs, Leech Lake, Upper Red and Lake of the Woods
families.theme: Living ice-fishing tip-up: a predator whose integral hinged frost dorsal flag snaps upright when prey is caught. Perch scout to walleye hunter to great walleye sentinel. Ice-lens brow is secondary anatomy.
evolution_design: Chunky three-bar perch with small crescent brow, tiny alert triangular dorsal fin and rounded tail trigger.
Elongated walleye with broad ice brow, single broad hinged flag dorsal and slightly curled muscular tail trigger.
Huge deep-bodied golden walleye with great two-lobed hinged frost flag, broad white ice rims and stout curved tail trigger.
silhouette: Small rounded fish, short spiny alert fin.
Longer jaw and single conspicuous upright flag lobe.
Deep heavy fish body and two huge angular flag lobes separated by clear notch.

sources.grounding: DNR describes a tip-up flag release signaling a bait take, walleye as perch-family low-light piscivores, and major Minnesota winter walleye lakes. Living flag fins and freezing lens anatomy are original fantasy inventions.
Perch body, dark vertical bars and spiny dorsal inspire compact young stage; three broad bars are a deliberate native56px abstraction.
